events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.95)
events.body: NS-0 routes this case: the driver cancelled and claimed the rider no-showed, so it is decided under NS-1/NS-2 [F3][RD-3 is not in play; RD-3 in NS-0 is not applicable]. The driver did tap "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5], so NS-1 (i) is met on the record [F5]. But NS-1 (ii) requires the GPS to place the driver at the pickup point at the moment of the tap: the trace records 600 m from the pickup at the tap, and the closest approach in the whole trip was 599 m, never within 200 m [F5][F1]. NS-1 (iii) also fails: after the 12:06:15 tap the driver spent 0 s inside the radius before cancelling at 12:09:25 [F5][F2]. The driver's 3 min 30 s stationary time was spent 600 m away, not at the pickup [F2]. Having failed (ii) and (iii), NS-1 does not make the $6.61 fee payable, and NS-2 requires full refund of the cancellation fee [F6][RD-2 is the refund branch of RD, not this fee; NS-2 applies]. Because the arrival confirmation ("I'm Here") was tapped while the GPS showed the driver well outside the pickup area, NS-2's additional account action is triggered, and the structured flag_account field is set [F5][F1][NS-2]. The chat is consistent with the rider's account and with the GPS: the driver claimed to be present at 12:06 and the rider replied at 12:07 that no car was at the pickup point [F8][F9][F10], and the driver's own post-trip statement repeats the verbal claim ("waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup") [F12], which the GPS contradicts [F1][F5][F2]. Rider and driver profile facts (rating, account age, prior dispute counts) are noted but do not decide anything on their own [F16][F17]. The amount refunded is the cancellation fee actually charged, $6.61 [F6][F3], the only fee in dispute on this no-show case. Safety screen: I read all three chat messages, the complaint and the driver's statement; the exchange is a factual standoff over location ("please come out", "no car here. Where are you?", "I have to cancel") — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, so safety_concern = none [F8][F9][F10][F12]. Evidence status: sufficient — the timeline and GPS fully settle the NS-1 (i)/(ii)/(iii) elements and the fare record settles the amount; the chat is complete and every message timestamped [F5][F1][F2][F3][F6][F11].

We're refunding the $6.61 you were charged as a Ryde voucher, which will be added to your account. No action is needed from you.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation on this trip. Because the arrival tap was recorded while your GPS showed you around 600 metres from the pickup point — and you never came within 200 metres of it — the no-show fee can't stand, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. Separately, your account is being sent to Ryde review over the arrival confirmation. A reviewer will look at your arrival tap, your GPS trace for the trip, and the trip timeline. No other action is needed from you right now.
